review: independent review round 3 of contract amendment 4 (worktree MINERvA-OmniFold-s5c-review3 at f511dcd6), 2026-09-25
verdict_on_the_evaluator: implements amendment 4 exactly (direction f_hat/(1+beta), se*f with the corrected f, truth untouched, exclusivity, futility path); data files reproduce D1 exactly; no threshold, Bonferroni, n or sigma change

H1.finding: the intervals Tier S would validate under amendment 4 (corrected, f_hat/(1+beta) +- ...) are not the intervals the measurement reports (f_hat +- sigma: the correction is not applied to data, KNOWN_ISSUES 75); plan section 7 requires validating the actual frozen intervals
H1.disposition: ACCEPTED. Scope of any Tier-S result under amendment 4 is restricted to the CORRECTED construction; it is not coverage of the reported uncorrected statistical intervals, and amendment 2 R3's S_PASS wording is superseded to that extent. The uncorrected reported construction is, on development evidence (D1), biased by 8-12 statistical sigma in the highest-W column and is NOT claimed to cover. Applying the correction to data would change the estimator (plan section 6: a matched central value) and its transfer is doubtful (H2); not done.

H2.finding: development experiment p3_tilt20_s2 (eavail_tilt a=0.2, on disk before the freeze) has highest-W residuals -1.8% to -2.9% against beta -3.5% to -4.1% (pulls +3.5 to +5.8); corrected, 59% of functionals inside 68% and 86% inside 95%
H2.disposition: ACCEPTED as a development PREDICTION that the tilt grid point fails. It is not a verdict: the plan's route to a FAIL on validation data is the futility rule, which the campaign runs (lines 0-119). The gate keeps its power (no false pass). F2 has no development revision left (plan section 6).

H3.finding: the E_avail tilt is w = 1 - a*E_avail/100 GeV: over the populated range it is a ~10% normalization change with at most ~1% shape change (tilt/nominal 0.9000-0.9210 on the 42 EW rows), not a +-10% shape departure
H3.disposition: ACCEPTED; amendment 4's and OUTCOME section 4.7's '+-10% tilt' wording is corrected here: with q3_given_eavail_w preserving the (E_avail,W) marginal, the M1 functionals are tested only against nominal truth and a ~10% normalization shift. Any Tier-S result states this domain.

M1.finding: beta noise is a fixed per-functional offset shared by all validation experiments; se in quadrature widens by ~3.4% at the median and does not protect a min-over-459 gate. Simulated P(pass at nominal): 0.39 (spread 0.79 sigma, realised beta noise), 0.00 (spread = sigma); leave-one-out pooled coverage 0.734/0.984
M1.disposition: ACCEPTED as a prediction; recorded with any result. 'The labels keep their meaning' in amendment 4 is overstated in both directions.

M2.finding: EW36-EW39 per-experiment spread is 1.29-1.51 sigma (median 0.79), consistent with the bootstrap not redrawing background (amendment 2 R3(c)); predicted 68% coverage 0.54-0.60 even with a perfect correction (9-experiment spreads, noisy)
M2.disposition: ACCEPTED as a prediction; the Tier-S sigma omits background-sampling variance, recorded as a construction limitation.

M3.finding: freshness met in substance (no validation product opened; 25 of 48 products predated the freeze, none with atime after mtime) but not in letter: plan section 7 and contract.json:66 say 'fresh validation seeds'. Factual slip: allocation 58861566 started 10:35:32Z (sacct Submit = Start), 32 s after the amendment-3 commit, not 10:33Z
M3.disposition: ACCEPTED. Recorded interpretation: 'fresh' is read as 'no information from these seeds has reached any decision', which the evidence supports; a reader who requires never-generated seeds should treat any amendment-4 Tier-S result as not meeting that letter. Start time corrected to 10:35:32Z.

M4.finding: three mutants (se dropped; se unscaled; correction ignored in --interim) survived the tests
M4.disposition: FIXED: two tests added (per-functional half-widths follow sqrt(sigma^2+(se f)^2); interim futility applies the correction); each of the three mutants now fails a test.

LOW.finding: half-width reported as one median, not per (functional, grid point) as declared; futility watcher fails open on a failed count and does not delete a stale result; p3_nominal_s1 serves both the sigma bootstrap and beta
LOW.disposition: FIXED the first two (halfwidth68_over_sigma per functional; watcher requires numeric equality and removes a stale result); the third is recorded.

resource_decision: Construction beyond allocations already running is HELD until the futility look (runs/futility/interim_400.json). Reason: every remaining construction product (the F2 covariance) is useful only if Tier S can pass, which H2, M1 and M2 predict it will not; the futility look needs only table lines 0-119, and putting every freed slot on them brings that decision several hours earlier. Held work stays committed (queues/cpu-construct.q, cpu-construct-2.q, gpu.q) and resumes on CONTINUE. This orders compute; it is not a scientific verdict.
family_decision: No third family is started on these grounds: D1 shows the same bias with the production estimator (F1), so neither F1 nor a seed-averaged F1 (F3) addresses the unmet requirement; plan section 6 advances families only for an unmet requirement a later family can meet. The method-level remedy (background treatment) is a costed next increment.
